passage:
automation — 自动化
Chen, wanted to discuss automation.

chatbot — 聊天机器人
'I think we should use a chatbot to answer simple questions,' he said.

empathy — 同理心
'A chatbot cannot show empathy.

replace — 取代
We should not replace people with machines.' She looked worried.

complex — 复杂的
The team will focus on complex issues.

relieved — 感到宽慰的
Tom will lead the training.' The team felt relieved.

senior — 资深的
Tom, a senior agent, raised his hand.

handle — 处理
The chatbot will only handle simple questions.
